comment: Evict + expired resume: three records pushed, then evict{up_to_seq=2} raises the floor to 3 (D7). A from=0 read is below the floor -> expired with next_cursor=floor-1=2 (D9); a spec-correct reader RESUMES from next_cursor and reads the retained tail rec3 -> data next=3; a seal after frame 3 then answers the head read eof (D12). All three clients (rs/ts/py) resume past expired per D9 (terminal states are eof/closed/failed ONLY); expired advances the cursor to next_cursor and re-reads.
